text:
maria: quick heads-up — VoltEdge shipped their initial kernel patch for the A7 board. thinking this is a good chance for a small joint perf run (perf/W + 99th-latency) before the marketplace listing. who can lead the runbook?

akash: I can take lead on the run orchestration. want to confirm scope: 4 models (gpt-small/med/large + embedder) at 8/16/32 batch, and long/short seq profiles?

lin: +1 on that scope. also add a steady-state 1h soak at target qps so we catch thermal throttles.

sofia (VoltEdge): happy to provide the patched kernel + telemetry hooks. we'll expose power rails and board temps via i2c sensors. i'll also publish a small helper script to map sensor ids.

maria: perfect. deliverables: (1) run plan doc, (2) reproducible infra scripts, (3) golden charts (perf/W + p99) and (4) short joint blurb for marketing. can we draft timelines?

akash: timeline proposal — day 0: infra prep + kernel deploy; day 1: dry-run (smoke); day 2: full sweep (throughputs & perf/W); day 3: analysis + charts. total 4 working days.

lin: note on metrics — please make sure tokenization and prompt lengths are identical across runs. we should checksum the model binaries and use seed prompts from shared promptset v0.3. i'll add a test that aborts if checksums mismatch.

sofia (VoltEdge): we'll sync firmware and prometheus exporters by EOD today. attaching sensor mapping here: `VE_A7_PWR0 -> i2c:1:0x40`, `VE_A7_TEMP0 -> i2c:1:0x41`

maria: for kernel tuning, can we try two knob sets: default and "latency-optimized" (preemptive IRQ tweaks + packed TLS)? if latency set regresses perf/W we should surface that in results.

akash: agreed. i'll encode knobs as a small json config per node, e.g.:

```json
{
  "profile": "latency-optimized",
  "irq_balance": "on",
  "cpu_gov": "performance",
  "scheduler_tune": "latency_hint"
}
```

lin: also instrument KV cache hit rates and token emission timing (per-token latencies). benchbot, can you include those metrics in the default export template?

benchbot: added metrics to template: [power_watts,total_tokens,p99_latency_ms,kv_cache_hit_pct,emit_time_per_token_ms,board_temp_c]. export file prefix: voltedge_a7_run_<ts>.csv

maria: great. Sofia — can your team sign off on publishing these traces to the shared S3 bucket with ACLs? we only need aggregated charts publicly, but raw traces can be shared to the partnership bucket for analysis.

sofia (VoltEdge): yes — we'll push raw traces under s3://ve-partner-shared/redwood-inference/voltedge-a7/1718888888/ with read ACL for both orgs. i'll coordinate creds with @maria offline.

akash: blockers — i need a small piece of infra: a dedicated bench node with 2xA7 and single control host. @lin can you provision a k3s node group and nomad job for the bench containers?

lin: will create the nodegroup and a simple nomad job spec. ping me if you need a particular docker image tag.

maria: communications/plans — i'd like a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to run through the checklist and confirm sign-offs (kernel, sensors, s3). calendar invite incoming.

sofia (VoltEdge): 10:30 PT works. excited to see the perf/W story. :rocket:

akash: logging action items here:
- akash: create runbook + nomad job templates (due +1d)
- lin: provisioning + checksum test (due +1d)
- sofia: push kernel + sensor mapping + s3 creds (due today)
- maria: draft co-announcement blurb and share PR template (due +3d)

maria: thanks all. we'll try to keep runs compact and iterate. if anyone hits infra noise (thermal/psu), call it out immediately in this thread.

sofia (VoltEdge): noted — will also include PSU serials in metadata for traceability. :white_check_mark:

akash: starting runbook now, will post link to draft in this thread when ready.

lin: added the nomad job here: https://internal.redwood/workspaces/benching/nomad/jobs/voltedge-a7-run — please review.

maria: nice. closing for now until the 10:30 sync.
